# ICPC NUB Community

The learning roadmap for the ICPC NUB Community: session recordings, problem sheets,
upsolve sessions and native slide decks, one topic at a time.

## Levels

- [Level 0 — The Foundation](/level0): data-types-and-conditions, loops, arrays, strings, functions-and-complexity, stl1, stl2
- [Level 1 — The Construction](/level1): locked, coming soon

## Topics

Each topic page lists three resources (session video, problem sheet, upsolve session) and a
native slide deck rendered from markdown in the repository.

- [Data Types & Conditions](/level0/data-types-and-conditions)
- [Loops](/level0/loops)
- [Arrays](/level0/arrays)
- [Strings](/level0/strings)
- [Functions & Complexity](/level0/functions-and-complexity)
- [STL 1](/level0/stl1)
- [STL 2](/level0/stl2)

## Notes

- Static single-page app. No accounts, no tracking, no server.
- Slides are authored as markdown files under `content/slides/<level>/<topic>.md`.
